text: ghatvāsuttaṃ [198] ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi kiṃsu ghatvā 2 sukhaṃ seti kiṃsu ghatvā na socati kissassa ekadhammassa vadhaṃ rocesi gotamāti . [199] kodhaṃ ghatvā sukhaṃ seti kodhaṃ ghatvā na socati kodhassa visamūlassa madhuraggassa devate vadhaṃ ariyā pasaṃsanti tañhi ghatvā na socatīti . dutiyaṃ
